body:
Adds a checkbox to toggle between 2D projected maps and 3D globe visualization in the main ClimaViz dashboard.

## Changes

- **`src/figures.jl`**: Added `create_main_figure_3d()` function that creates a 3D globe using `GeoMakie.GlobeAxis` (equirectangular projection for 2D, globe for 3D)
- **`src/dashboard.jl`**: Create dual figure setup with both 2D and 3D views, add "3D Globe" checkbox, synchronize titles and dark mode between views
- **`src/layout.jl`**: Add "3D Globe" checkbox to Menu card, use `@lift` macro to reactively swap displayed figure

## Implementation

```julia
# Checkbox toggles between two pre-rendered figures
globe_3d_checkbox = Checkbox(false)

# 2D uses equirectangular projection
ax = GeoAxis(fig[1, 1], title = title, dest = "+proj=eqc")

# 3D uses GlobeAxis
ax_3d = GeoMakie.GlobeAxis(fig_3d[1, 1]; show_axis = false, title = title_3d)

# Reactive toggle in layout
map_fig = @lift($(globe_3d) ? fig_3d : fig)
```

Both visualization modes display the same simulation data with automatic synchronization. Dark mode support is included for both views.

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> Look at https://docs.makie.org/dev/reference/blocks/box and https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaViz.jl/blob/main/animations/clouds/cloud_animation_3d.jl - use that information to add a checkbox labeled "3D globe" to the menu. If that checkbox is selected, hide the box of the surface figure ( put it in a Makie.box first of course), and instead show the same surface but in a 3D axis (as in the cloud 3d code). Basically you just make another figure in GeoMakie.globeaxis, out it in a Makie.box, and depending of the checkbox you show the surface in a 2d axis or 3d axis. I hope it makes sense!


</details>
